propositions: Header values resolved from ${run:...} references are not currently passed to the model call, preventing gateway attribution and grouping of gate calls.
Header values must be redacted from durable records like verdicts and sidecars to prevent operator-supplied values from leaking into recorded provenance.
The extra_headers dict must be copied per-call rather than reused from config to prevent mutation of the config mapping and non-deterministic provenance due to injected fields like User-Agent.
Headers should only be attached when base_url is configured, as they are inert for direct provider calls and should not reach public APIs.
A ${run:...} reference that cannot be resolved outside a gate-run scope should omit the header entirely rather than fail or send an empty value.
Header name validation must occur both pre-substitution and post-substitution to catch values that become unsafe only after ${run:...} interpolation.
